text:
alex: Deployed patch for CVE-2026-2817 (OpenSSL) to hosted + dedicated; canary at 5% now. Starting post-patch validation checklist. Please watch errors and perf dashboards. :eyes:

samir: Thanks — what's the validation checklist? smoke, perf, canary metrics, audit logs, KMS access, anything else?

alex: Checklist I'm running:
- smoke tests (api simple flows)
- auth / TLS handshake tests
- integration tests for token encryption (KMS)
- perf regression job (p50/p95 across seq lengths)
- canary increment policy (5 -> 25 -> 100) w/ 4h hold each
- audit log sampling for any key access errors

jordan: Perf numbers from quick run vs baseline: p50 +2ms, p95 +9ms for 2048-token sequences on dedicated; hosted p95 unchanged. No error spike in logs so far.

maya.k: Running smoke suite now: `./ci/smoke.sh --suite=open-ssl`
maya.k: smoke results: all endpoints OK except one flaky TLS handshake in private-region-2 (1/120 requests failed). Retrying services there.

alex: saw that too — I restarted the private-instance-3 process, handshake failures cleared. Suspect a socket reuse cornercase after update. Filing a follow-up to eng-runtime.

jordan: Can we run the perf regression job for canary nodes? Command: `./infra/perf/run_regression --tag openssl-cve-2026-2817 --duration 30m`
alex: kicked off perf job against canary fleet. Initial metrics: CPU +3%, GPU unaffected, token throughput stable.

deploy-bot: canary rollout update: 5% -> 25% scheduled at 1762005600. Monitoring hooks attached (errors, latency, TLS-failures).

samir: Reminder: check KMS permission audit. If any service account lost access during rolling restart we need to rotate key role back. Run: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY_NAME --location=global` or `vault audit list` for on-prem.

maya.k: KMS checks: sampled 100 operations, all show successful encrypt/decrypt. No permission denies in audit logs for the last 2h.

alex: Observability checks:
- SLO: 99.9% success for generation endpoints maintained.
- Error budget consumption unchanged.
- No spike in 5xx or TLS handshake errors after restart.

jordan: Note — there is a minor ~7% increase in median prepare-time for long sequence batches (seq>1024). Likely additional OpenSSL path cost. Not critical but flagging for optimize/quantization team.

samir: Agree. Prioritization: because exploit requires local code execution and we patched, primary objective is complete rollout. Perf regression is medium priority — create a perf ticket with repro steps.

alex: Plan: promote to 100% at 1762008000 if no regressions/alerts. Otherwise rollback plan ready. I'll leave canary at 25% for a 4h observation window.

deploy-bot: rollout progressed: 25% -> 100% at 1762008000 (auto-promote).

maya.k: Post-promo quick check: smoke suite run against a 10% sample across regions: all green.

jordan: Post-promo perf snapshot: p95 increase persists on long sequences by ~8ms, p50 negligible. Will add to perf backlog.

alex: Audit log and KMS final check: no denies, key rotation not needed. Closing patch ticket after 24h quiet window. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
